item.title: Claude Code Won't Report Progress? A Prompt to Make It a Real-Time Announcer
item.description: When Claude Code works on long tasks, it acts like an intern who never speaks up—you just wait in the dark. This article shares a CLAUDE.md prompt recipe verified across 30+ real projects that makes AI proactively break down tasks and report progress, with 5 copy-paste templates and 3 advanced techniques.

item.title: Claude Code Agents & Teams Practical Guide: Config Done But Don't Know How to Use? This Article Explains It All
item.description: A practical guide for operating Claude Code Subagents and Agent Teams from creation to triggering. Includes Subagent YAML configuration templates, 4 trigger Prompt writing methods, Agent Teams enabling methods, and 6 shortcut key references - copy and use.

item.title: I Spent $400 on Claude Code, Then Switched to Codex
item.description: After a month and $400, I went from being a Claude Code fanatic to a Codex user. This is a real user experience report.
